description: Brutalist studio page: black borders, monospace type, zero radius, one yellow accent block.

referenceProfile.thesis: Structure is the aesthetic: visible 4px black borders divide the page into cells, and monospace uppercase type replaces decoration entirely.
signatureMoves: An inverted black cell inside the three-cell grid creates contrast without imagery.
A single saturated yellow block carries all emphasis on the page.
transferPreserve: Keep borders visible, corners square, and type in uppercase monospace.
transferAvoid: Do not add rounded corners, shadows, gradients, or soft pastel surfaces.
